description: This file provides stub implementations for authentication and notes management APIs in a frontend application, using localStorage for data storage. It defines functions for login, logout, signup, retrieving and managing notes, and category handling.

methods.name: login({ email, password })
methods.description: Stub login function that accepts any non-empty email and password, stores user info in localStorage, and resolves a Promise with user email.

methods.name: logout()
methods.description: Removes the user item from localStorage to simulate logging out.

methods.name: signup({ email, password })
methods.description: Stub signup function that accepts any non-empty email and password, stores user info, and resolves a Promise with user email.

methods.name: getCurrentUser()
methods.description: Returns the current logged-in user object from localStorage, or null if none exists.

methods.name: getNotes()
methods.description: Retrieves all notes stored in localStorage as an array.

methods.name: createNote({ title, content, category })
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title, content, and category, assigns a unique ID, and saves it in localStorage.

methods.name: updateNote(id, { title, content, category })
methods.description: Updates a note identified by ID with new data; rejects if note not found.

methods.name: deleteNote(id)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID from localStorage.

methods.name: searchNotes(query)
methods.description: Searches notes for a query string in title or content, case-insensitive, and returns matching notes.

methods.name: getCategories()
methods.description: Returns a list of unique categories present in notes, prefixed with 'All'.

ctags.name: createNote
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createNote({ title, content, category }) {$/

ctags.name: updateNote
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateNote(id, { title, content, category }) {$/
